When reviewing a pull request that changes user-visible behavior, UI labels,
commands, ports, configuration, APIs, or contributor workflows, check whether
the corresponding README files and pages under `docs/src/content/docs/` also
need changes. Report only evidence-backed documentation discrepancies and cite
both the stale documentation and the implementation, test, or configuration
that conflicts with it. Treat AI documentation feedback as advisory and do not
approve changes solely because an automated review found no issues.
